title: Nutty Venezuelan Peanuts Stew
description: A light, nutty Venezuelan stew featuring dried chilies and steamed mushrooms, ideal for meal prep and low‑fat dining.
instructions: Soak the raw peanuts in water for 4 hours, then drain and set aside.
Heat a splash of oil in a large pot and sauté onion, garlic, and carrot until softened.
Add diced tomatoes and crushed dried chilies to the pot, cooking for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth, bring to a simmer, and let it cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the soaked peanuts, sliced mushrooms, and spinach, then simmer for an additional 8 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste, adjusting the heat with extra chilies if desired.
Transfer the stew to a preheated earthenware bowl, ensuring the bowl is warm to keep the stew hot.
Serve immediately, optionally garnishing with a sprinkle of chopped peanuts or fresh cilantro.
